name: Mark Copy
description_en:
The product historically listed as Mark Copy now presents itself as Mark AI, a content operating platform for marketing teams. It combines reference knowledge, brand rules, specialized agents and multi-format or multilingual production. The current homepage describes human review and approval before publication.

This is a governed team-content workflow rather than only a personal text generator. The pricing page still uses older Mark Copy branding and a different module vocabulary, so current package mapping and billing need confirmation instead of merging every homepage capability into one legacy Team price.
description_zh:
原目录 Mark Copy 现以 Mark AI 内容运营平台呈现，面向营销团队，结合参考知识、品牌规则、专用 Agent 及多格式/语言生产，现行首页说明发布前由人审核批准。

这是一种团队内容治理流程，不只是个人生成器。价格页仍用旧 Mark Copy 品牌与不同模块词汇，需确认现行组合及账期，不能把首页所有能力拼进旧 Team 价格。

core_features.explanation_en: Configure terminology, audience and approved reference material for generation.
core_features.explanation_zh: 为生成配置术语、受众及已批准参考。

core_features.explanation_en: Prepare multi-format drafts and keep approval in the workflow.
core_features.explanation_zh: 准备多格式初稿并在流程保留批准。

en: Create a source-checked launch article and localized variants under brand approval.
zh: 在品牌批准流程内生成有来源发布文章及本地化版本。
use_cases.basis: Editorial task suggestions based on official documentation; no observed deployment.

steps.en: Import approved brand facts, generate one multi-format brief and validate reviewer permissions and final output before scaling.
steps.zh: 导入已批准品牌事实，生成一次多格式内容，扩大前核对审核权限与结果。

items.en: Selection judgments and examples are documentation-based; no live workflow was tested.
items.zh: 选型判断与例子依据文档，未实测真实流程。

pricing.billing_basis: Team/brand/workspace subscription and custom enterprise scope.
pricing.source_snapshot_en: Team displays €750/month for up to five users/one brand AI/workspace; Enterprise custom. Extra-workspace text +€750/month. Billing selectors show conflicting discount labels, and legacy pricing/new Content OS module mapping is unresolved; obtain the actual proposal.
pricing.source_snapshot_zh: Team 展示月 €750、最多 5 人/1 品牌 AI/空间，Enterprise 定制，额外空间文字加月 €750。账期折扣标签冲突，旧价格与新模块映射未定，需真实提案。

sources.title: Mark AI - The Content OS for Marketing Teams
sources.research_notes_en: Current Mark AI Content OS: knowledge/brand rules, specialized agents and human approval; French homepage security promises not independently audited.

sources.title: Plans & Pricing - Mark Copy AI
sources.research_notes_en: Mark Copy-branded pricing page Team €750/month/up to five users and custom Enterprise; billing-discount labels and newer module mapping need confirmation.

official_check.scope: Public official documents read; no purchase, account setup, independent review, hands-on test, identity verification or publication approval.

review_notes: Official documentation describes vendor functionality, not independent evidence of reliability, adoption or outcomes.
Original English synthesis and corresponding Chinese draft; examples and fit judgments are editorial guidance.
Current public pricing is a dated snapshot; purchase conditions remain subject to vendor confirmation.

sections.title_en: Build the brand rules before generating campaign variants
sections.title_zh: 先设品牌规则，再生成活动版本
sections.en: For an illustrative launch, provide approved product facts, prohibited claims, terminology and audience examples. Generate an article, social post and localized version, then compare prices, limits and legal wording across them. The homepage says source/history and approval are retained; this research did not test whether a draft can bypass approval or how corrections propagate.
sections.zh: 例如发布活动，应提供已批准产品事实、禁用主张、术语和受众示例，再生成文章、社交稿及本地化版本，核对价格、限制和必要措辞。首页称保留来源/历史与批准，本文未测试是否可绕过批准或如何传播更正。

sections.title_en: Reconcile current modules with the older price page
sections.title_zh: 核对现行模块与旧价格页
sections.en: Team displays €750/month, up to five users, one brand AI and one collaborative workspace. Enterprise is custom and lists additional brands/workspaces and onboarding. The page mixes 20% and 30% discount wording beside monthly/yearly controls, so no reliable annual total is inferred. Additional workspace text says +€750/month. Confirm the actual quote, newer Content OS modules, limits and services; unlimited generation is not a guarantee of unlimited deployment or integrations.
sections.zh: Team 展示每月 €750、最多 5 人、1 品牌 AI 和 1 协作空间；Enterprise 定制，列更多品牌/空间及培训。月/年选择旁同时出现 20% 和 30% 折扣，不推断可靠年总额，额外空间文字为每月加 €750。需确认报价、新 Content OS 模块、上限和服务，不限生成不保证无限部署或集成。

sections.title_en: Source-grounding and brand compliance still need review
sections.title_zh: 来源约束及品牌合规仍需审核
sections.en: The vendor says outputs use approved knowledge and do not invent missing facts. Treat this as a described design: test an unsupported question, an outdated source and a conflicting brand rule. A source-linked claim can still be overstated. Homepage France-hosting/no-training statements need the applicable contract and security documentation before confidential uploads. No factual accuracy, multilingual quality, SEO result or security claim was independently measured.
sections.zh: 厂商称使用已批准知识且不编造缺失事实，应作为设计描述，并测试无支持问题、过期来源及冲突品牌规则。有来源的主张仍可能夸大。上传机密前，法国托管/不训练说法需结合合同及安全资料。本文未独立测量准确性、多语言质量、SEO 或安全。

sections.title_en: Evaluate team governance and the actual publication route
sections.title_zh: 评估团队治理及真实发布路径
sections.en: Mark AI merits investigation when several teams need consistent terminology and expert approval. A solo short-draft task may not justify a team platform. Pilot knowledge import, review roles, revision history and one controlled export/publication. No source license, self-hosted package, connector, agent or approval flow was executed or verified.
sections.zh: 多个团队需要一致术语及专家批准时可研究 Mark AI，个人短稿未必需要团队平台。建议试验知识导入、审核角色、修订历史及一次受控导出/发布。本文未执行或确认源码许可、自托管、连接、Agent 或批准流程。

research_gaps: No agent, knowledge import, approval, publication, translation or security control was tested.
Legacy/current plan mapping, discount/billing, service scope, contractual hosting/training terms, license and self-hosting remain unverified.

content_method.author: Codex (AI assistant)
content_method.method: Public primary-source research, original English editorial synthesis and Chinese translation. Hypothetical examples are not executed tests.
